title: the tier record reader never raises

findings.claim: tier_value.measured raised RecursionError on a tier record nested about 200000 deep and read a record of any size, against its never-raises promise (D-1322)
findings.place: libs/tb_common/tier_value.py measured; tools/tier_record.py load and check
findings.expected: a replaced record gives malformed with a fixed reason; the checker refuses it with exit 3
findings.happened: RecursionError from json.loads in the reader and a traceback from the checker (reported by lane J on PR #1157)
